issue_context.title: busctl introspect fails to show values for properties
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

252.4

### Used distribution

Gentoo

### Linux kernel version used

5.15.85-gentoo-dist

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

x86_64

### Component

_No response_

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

busctl introspect should show values for properties

```
$ busctl introspect org.freedesktop.network1 /org/freedesktop/network1                                            
NAME                                TYPE      SIGNATURE RESULT/VALUE FLAGS
org.freedesktop.DBus.Introspectable interface -         -            -
.Introspect                         method    -         s            -

.Get                                method    ss        v            -

.Set                                method    ssv       -            -
.PropertiesChanged                  signal    sa{sv}as  -            -
org.freedesktop.network1.Manager    interface -         -            -
.Describe                           method    -         s            -

.OnlineState                        property  s         "online"     emits-change
.OperationalState                   property  s         "routable"   emits-change
```

### Unexpected behaviour you saw

But it seems that f2f7785d7a47ffa48ac929648794e1288509ddd8 broke something so that no property values are shown. I rebuilt the package with a patch to revert this particular commit and now property values are shown again.

```
$ busctl introspect org.freedesktop.resolve1 /org/freedesktop/resolve1
```

### Steps to reproduce the problem

Can be reproduced by introspecting any d-bus object that has properties

```
busctl introspect org.freedesktop.network1 /org/freedesktop/network1
````

### Additional program output to the terminal or log subsystem illustrating the issue

_No response_
